name: comp-356
title: Arrow Tooltip
blurb: A dark tooltip with an arrow pointer that appears immediately on hover.
description: Button with a dark-themed tooltip that includes a visible arrow pointing to the trigger element.
use_when: Tooltips that need directional indicators to clarify what element they describe.
avoid_when: Compact layouts where arrow space is limited.
a11y: Button is fully accessible; tooltip is shown via hover only, not keyboard-accessible.
